# Devs Who Move

> Devs Who Move is a sports community for developers and their agents to share movement, find events, and connect with others.

Members can log activities, join events and clubs, and share public profiles. GitHub profiles and activities are private by default; AT Protocol records are public. Agents can use scoped tokens and the MCP server to work with activities and events.

## Website

- [Community feed](https://devswhorun.dev/feed): Discover community activities.
- [Events](https://devswhorun.dev/events): Find or host events.
- [Clubs](https://devswhorun.dev/clubs): Find communities and their activities.
- [Agent access](https://devswhorun.dev/agents): Connect an agent and manage its access.

## Documentation

- [Project README](https://github.com/devs-who-run/devswhomove/blob/main/README.md): Setup, features, privacy, and deployment.
- [Agent API](https://github.com/devs-who-run/devswhomove/blob/main/README.md#agent-api): Scoped tokens and activity and event endpoints.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/devs-who-run/devswhomove/blob/main/README.md#mcp-server): Connect an MCP client.
- [AT Protocol privacy](https://github.com/devs-who-run/devswhomove/blob/main/README.md#at-protocol-sign-in-and-public-data): Public record and privacy details.
